thread.title: Apple to discount prices of cheaper iPhone X in Japan: WSJ - MarketWatch

author: Barbara Kollmeyer
title: Apple to discount prices of cheaper iPhone X in Japan: WSJ - MarketWatch
text:
Japan's big wireless firms may cut prices of Apple Inc.'s AAPL, -0.11% cheapest new iPhone -- the XR -- next week, due to subsidies being offered by the company, The Wall Street Journal reported Thursday, citing sources. Concerns over demand for Apple's newest phones have weighed on the stock since a poorly received earnings report earlier this month. Foxconn Industrial Internet Co. 601138, -4.99% Apple's biggest iPhone manufacturer, said earlier in the week that it would slash costs by $2.9 billion, owing to a "difficult and competitive year." A profit and revenue warning from optical equipment supplier Lumentum Holdings Inc. LITE, +0.88% , which counts Apple as one of its biggest customers, triggered sharp losses for the iPhone maker last week. Apple shares closed at $176.78 on Wednesday, 23.7% below an Oct. 3 record close of $232.07. Many on Wall Street define a bear market as a decline of 20% or more from a bull-market high.
